conditions.text: Measure success only if the answer uses the actual task titles exactly, not approximate title strings merely accepted by the native fuzzy STRING_MATCH rule.
conditions.rationale: The prompt asks for the task titles only, but native checking uses case-insensitive fuzzy matching (`fuzzy_match` threshold 0.9), so near-miss spellings or paraphrases can pass natively.

conditions.text: When multiple tasks are due, measure success only if each expected title appears exactly once in the answer; duplicates should not count as covering multiple expected tasks.
conditions.rationale: The prompt asks which tasks are due, but native checking only requires equal list lengths and that each submitted item matches some expected title, so repeated matching to the same expected title can still pass.
